subject: VeritasEdge SIG questionnaire — control ownership & evidence-stamp coordination
messages:
From: Tom Liu <tom.liu@veritasedge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@veritasedge.com>; procurement@veritasedge.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire — control owners and evidence stamping

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking our SIG intake — we pushed the questionnaire through and the security team wants clarity on a couple of fields before we hand this to our auditors: specifically, for each control in the SIG, we need (a) the named control owner at Redwood, (b) the canonical artifact you will provide (log extracts, config screenshots, policy PDFs), and (c) a one-line statement of how often the artifact is refreshed/stamped (daily/weekly/monthly) and retention period.

We received earlier references to a "control map" and an "evidence inventory" — can you confirm those documents and whether they will be updated to include a signature or date stamp to make them auditable? Also if there are any SLA exceptions or long-term retention variances we should flag now, please call them out.

Target timeline from our side: final SIG package to auditors next Friday (3/31). Do you have bandwidth for a short call tomorrow to align?

Best,
Tom
Security Programs Manager
VeritasEdge Inc.

Attachments: none

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tom Liu <tom.liu@veritasedge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — control owners and evidence stamping

Tom — thanks for the note and clear asks. Short answer: we can provide a control ownership map and an evidence inventory with per-artifact timestamps. A couple of clarifications so we scope exactly what you need before the call: 

- Do you prefer artifacts delivered as individual files (CSV/PDF/PNG) or as a consolidated ZIP manifest plus a signed control map?
- For "stamping": we can include an automated timestamp column for exported logs and a signed PDF control map indicating owner names and roles. Do you need an electronic signature (PKI) or is a printed-and-signed PDF acceptable to your auditors?
- Any specific controls you want prioritized (e.g., key management, privileged access, telemetry retention)?

Kimberly and Marissa — can you confirm feasibility for the 3/31 target and prep the initial artifacts if we agree the scope? I can take the call tomorrow at 9:00 AM PT.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Enterprise Sales (Security Focus)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Tom Liu <tom.liu@veritasedge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — control owners and evidence stamping

Following up with the technical side — we can produce the artifacts you requested. Planned deliverables:

1) redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx — sheet per control family listing control_id, short description, primary owner (name + role), secondary owner, evidence type, evidence filename, refresh cadence, retention window.

2) redwood_artifact_inventory_2028-03-20.csv — export of the actual artifact filenames and paths, with a last_refreshed_iso timestamp column.

3) architecture_diagram_v2.png — updated network/tenant diagram highlighting data boundaries for VeritasEdge (for SIG scoping).

Notes/choices:
- For artifacts we will include a last-generated timestamp in exports and also a manifest PDF (control-map-signed.pdf) with an approval line. We do not currently provide PKI-level timestamping for ad-hoc exports but can include an HSM-signed notarization for an added compliance fee or as part of Dedicated/Private engagements.
- Key management control (SIG ID KMS-01) will show KMS owner: "Ops — Mateo Alvarez" and retention: keys rotate every 90 days; rotation proofs are in the artifact list.

I'll prepare a first-pass control map and inventory by EOD and share the Drive link.

Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (stubs) redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), architecture_diagram_v2.png (image)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@veritasedge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — control owners and evidence stamping

Thanks — and adding artifact acceptance criteria from our assurance playbook so VeritasEdge auditors have clarity:

- Logs: CSV export with header, timezone in ISO8601, and a last_exported_at column. Minimum window: 30 days for platform-level telemetry; retention policy reflected in control map.
- Config snapshots: PDF snapshots include filename, path, and an exported_at timestamp. If the auditor requests image metadata we can include MD5 checksums.
- Policy docs: PDF with version header and an approval line (name, title, date).
- Evidence freshness: anything marked "weekly" will be produced with the most recent weekly snapshot (we will include the snapshot date in the manifest).

I've started the redwood_artifact_inventory CSV and will attach sample rows to the Drive folder. Tom — would your auditors accept MD5 checksums and the signed control map PDF as sufficient chain-of-custody evidence? If not, tell us what form of notarization they require.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Staff Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: redwood_artifact_inventory_2028-03-20.csv

From: Tom Liu <tom.liu@veritasedge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@veritasedge.com>, kimberly.park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@veritasedge.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — control owners and evidence stamping

Sean / Team — appreciate the rapid turnaround and the sample artifacts in Drive. A couple of clarifications before we close the package: 

1) The auditors requested explicit owner emails on the control map (for contact verification). Please include primary_owner_email and secondary_owner_email fields in the XLSX.
2) For the KMS rotation proofs, they asked for a signed rotation log. If you cannot provide an HSM-signed notarization, the MD5 checksums + signed PDF will be acceptable.
3) One more ask: any SLA exceptions for log retention (e.g., aggregated telemetry stored at 7 days for hosted API tier) must be listed. We have a waiver process but need the list to pre-authorize.

We confirm the 3/31 target — procurement will accept the artifact bundle plus control-map-signed.pdf and the CSV inventory. If you can surface the control-map-signed.pdf in Drive today and include contact emails, we will route to auditors this afternoon.

Thanks,
Tom
Security Programs Manager
VeritasEdge Inc.

Attachments referenced: none

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tom Liu <tom.liu@veritasedge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — control owners and evidence stamping

Tom — will do. Kimberly: can you add owner emails and publish control-map-signed.pdf to the shared folder by EOD PT? Marissa: please attach the MD5 checksum column in the inventory and flag log-retention SLOs/waivers (we have hosted-api default aggregate retention of 7 days; Dedicated customers can request extended retention per contract). I'll confirm when uploaded.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Enterprise Sales (Security Focus)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
